assessment: This manuscript provides the first experimental evidence that some members of the newly discovered heliorhodopsins can function as proton channels. The authors provide evidence of this transport function as well as a characterization of the photo cycle. The authors also demonstrate that these heliorhodopsin proton channels can be utilized as optogenetic tools. These findings should be of interest to a wide audience interested in membrane biophysics as well as in the development of tools for neuroscience.
